name: Rich "Buffaloverflow" Warren
biography: Red Team Operator at AmberWolf and Microsoft Top 100 Security Researcher (formerly with NCC Group). Co-presenter of 'Very Pwnable Networks: Exploiting the Top Corporate VPN Clients…' at HackFest Hollywood 2024. Richard has a track record of discovering novel vulnerabilities in VPN and zero-trust clients and has contributed to multiple high-profile vulnerability disclosures and tools in the offensive security community.
